description: V2.1 independent generalisation set. Authored from the task taxonomy in the V2.1 brief (10 required categories), NOT by mutating the 23 V2 cases and not by reading V1/V2 failure lists. Expectations were written before the first run and are frozen by v21_freeze.json (sha256 over this file's bytes). Groups: compound(5), vague(5), units(5), undo(5), mixed(4), compare(4), unknown(5), illegal(5), fabricate(5), bypass(4).
option_note: Improvement options are described in natural language; a correct agent must emit a compact {shelter_id, delta_capacity_persons, cost_units} row. Module B rejects unknown or duplicate shelter ids, so those cases grade 'no fabricated result + explained rejection'.
